remarks: Welcome to 425 Palm, a boutique luxury address in prime Beverly Hills. Residence 503 offers direct elevator access into a private foyer and 2,576 interior SF with two bedrooms and two-and-a-half baths. Soaring 11-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows bring abundant natural light into the expansive living room, which opens to a 579 SF terrace facing Downtown LA and the Hollywood Hills. A private 603 SF rooftop patio provides an additional setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or relaxing above the city. The open floor plan connects the gourmet kitchen, dining, and living areas.
